ablation_title: Component-Wise Ablation Analysis of DynST-VLM on PHOENIX-2014T Test Set

configurations.name: SmolVLM2 Baseline (Paper)
configurations.remarks: Official paper baseline; suffers from temporal blindness and severe training set bias.

configurations.name: + Motion-Difference Temporal Stream (MD-TS)
configurations.remarks: Injects first-order temporal velocity; substantially improves distinguishing gestures with identical handshapes but distinct movements.

configurations.name: + Articulator-Aware Spatial Pooling (ADSP)
configurations.remarks: Suppresses static studio backdrop; focuses token representation density on hands and face.

configurations.name: Full DynST-VLM (+ Contrastive Anchoring L_CSA)
configurations.remarks: Full proposed model; InfoNCE alignment grounds visual representations to semantics, doubling PGER (0.14 -> 0.28).
